items.title: Weapons Expansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Discover a wide array of new weapons! From mighty spears to razor-sharp swords and powerful staves, we have it all! Unleash your creativity and arm yourself with the finest arsenal!

+ 26 new weapons!
+ Boss fight!
+ 6 new ores!
+ 4 new armor sets!
+ Arena system included!
+ Licensed by Tucano Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: GARDENING
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
It's time to add new life to your garden. Gardening brings hundreds of new plant life that can be discovered worldwide. Walk through vibrant meadows of flowers or find the hardiest plants sprouting from sandy deserts. Gardening also offers new ways to decorate your outdoor spaces with new bird baths, benches, gnomes and more!

+ Made by Podcrash

items.title: Soul Shifters
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Soul Shifters blur the line between human and shadow. Black souls pulse beneath their skin as molten lava pours through cracks in their bodies. 
Shifting forms and burning power make them a force you can't ignore.

+ 8 Skins

items.title: My Skins Your Skins!
items.creator: Eescal Studios
items.description: Unleash your style with custom dark anime skins. From cursed heroes to shadowy villains, you will bring a bold edge to your world.

items.title: PixelPals: Evolved Add-On 1.1
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Battle, capture, and evolve in this expansive, pet Add-On. Fight to level up your pets and unlock new evolutions. Explore to capture every pal and prove your collecting prowess.
- 102 new pets to capture, level up, evolve, and battle
- 10 new items to enhance your trainer evolution
- New ores, wandering trainer battles, and more

Be the best; collect them all!
items.changelog:
Hotfix 1.1 updates:
- Fixed Vibrant Visuals compatibility issues with the UI
- Added an automatic aim-assist when capturing PixelPals
- Various GUI improvements
- Various bug fixes

items.title: Dark Rose
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Harness the color of rose with these brave new warriors. Check out these 8 awesome skins to upgrade your wardrobe with their mysterious entity vibe. Show off this new trend today! 
-1 free skin!

items.title: United Earth Planetary Station
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Explore the first human settlement on a hostile alien planet, and help protect it from the overworld!

+ Mega sci-fi base with over 500+ areas to explore
+ Large hangers, underground bunkers, derelict tunnels, and control towers
+ Unique spaceships, vehicles, mobs, defensive laser turrets, and more
+ Custom textures, scenery, and skins

From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Show off in snazzy outfits, flashy hairstyles, and dresses. From cool street styles to elegant ensembles, be the ultimate style star of the server. Level up your look and dominate the fashion scene!

+ 1 Free Skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Aphmau’s Monster High
items.creator: CatFace
items.description:
Creep it real with Aphmau's Monster High Skins! Packed with fang-tastic looks straight from the halls of The Aphmau Movies, transform into your favorite crew creatures and bring their spooktacular style to your adventures—because at Monster High, it’s cool to be different!

Pack includes:
2 Aphmau Skins
1 Aaron Skin
And 9 Crew skins including Ivy, Pierce and more!

items.title: Savage Crew
items.creator: Block Perfect Studios
items.description:
Join the Savage Crew! Dress up as cool, tough teens ready for action. Pick your favorite look and explore your world in style with your awesome new crew!
-8 trendy teen skins.
-Perfect for roleplay.

items.title: Zero Drive
items.creator: DeliSoft Studios
items.description:
Blast off into the adrenaline-fueled world of Zero Drive, where you’ll race cutting-edge spaceships against cunning Space Pirates on thrilling, obstacle-filled tracks. Unlock powerful ships and uncharted maps in the shop, each more daring and treacherous than the last!

+ Choose from 14 unique spaceships
+ Custom Music & Texture
+ Power Ups

items.title: Ultimate Anime
items.creator: Street Studios
items.description:
How about anime style clothes? I'm sure you'll look fancy in these outfits!

- 12 skins
- 2 free skins included

items.title: Electrical Creativity Add-On
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Electrify your world with Electrical Creativity! An Add-On that redefines interaction and possibilities with a variety of new blocks and items.

Advanced power systems
Automation & smart sensors
Specialized crafting & recharging tables
Plasma tools & weapons
DNA capsules & digital mobs
Unique & functional blocks
Transform your gaming experience with limitless creativity!
items.changelog:
Null Sector:
- New underground biome with its own structures and ores.
- 19 new blocks.
- 5 new items.
- New digital creatures.
- Vibrant Visuals support added.

items.title: Soulfire Zombies
items.creator: Time Trap Studios
items.description:
Grungy dark zombies pour up from the soulfire valleys. With blue flames and glowing eyes these mobs will be sure to be the heat of the attraction!
- 20 Soulfire Zombie Skins
- 1 Free Fiery Skin
- Join them in The Nether
- By Time Trap Studios

items.title: Entity 303
items.creator: Snail Studios
items.description:
Unravel the error affecting Entity 303! Get to the bottom of the creepypasta's corruption. Error 303 is up to some dark, nefarious deeds!
+3 Entity 303 inspired skins, 5 skins in total

items.title: Props and Stuff
items.creator: WildPhire
items.description:
Think your builds need a little extra charm without going all-in on furniture packs?

Then Props and Stuff is just what you need!

- 350+ Custom Blocks 
- Mini Armor Stands 
- 120+ Unique Plants 
- Placeable Potions 
- Tons of Fun Decorations
items.changelog:
- Changes in new update 
- Updated Plant Pot textures
- Changed Bronze to Copper for the Trophies
- Added 15 New Trophies (Diamond, Emerald, Netherite)
- Updated Other Small Textures

items.title: Claims Adjuster Add-On
items.creator: Minecraft
items.description:
Minecraft Claims Adjuster Add-On!

Tired of losing your hard-earned loot when you die? We’re sorry for your loss. 

File your claim today by answering a “few” soul-crushing questions, and we’ll help you get your stuff back in no time! 

Should you have any issues with your claim, remember your adjuster is doing their best to protect you from the system!

items.title: Red Goths
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Become elite with this trendy pack of gothic skins! Change into these dark red skins and stand out from the others while playing with friends!

- 10 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Quest Craft
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Embark on thrilling quests and earn epic rewards! Meet a curious explorer, a sneaky merchant, and a deep miner on your journeys. And don’t worry about missing rewards—the unstoppable postman delivers them straight to you!
- 150+ quests
- 4 new NPC’s and a village quest board
- Unique quest items, rewards and interactions
- Hassle-free questing with no backtracking

items.title: Pet Weapons
items.creator: Tristan Productions
items.description:
Unlock the magic of companionship: Tame charming pet allies, harness their unique abilities, and let their bond enhance your magical weapons for an unforgettable magical journey!

- 6 powerful weapons
- 6 cute pets
- Each weapon has abilities and a powerful ultimate
- Stats, cutscenes, and more!

items.title: Ultimate Parkour Grid
items.creator: Tristan Productions
items.description:
Are you up for a parkour challenge? This parkour grid is equipped with 100 levels that progressively get harder! 
+ Lots of biomes and builds
+ Unique jumps that require creative thinking
+ Multiplayer or singleplayer

items.title: Ender Demon HD
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Spook your friends with these HD detailed ender demon outfits! With royal purple accents on void-black monsters, you're sure to stand out and look unstoppable.

+ Includes 12 skins!
+ By Yeggs

items.title: Kitty Kawaii
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Meow! Zoom around the overworld wearing the latest in pastel feline fashion. Twelve unique skins included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Biome Bosses
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Search for dungeons and take on powerful biome bosses. Each boss has its own difficulty, with special powers and unique challenges that make every battle exciting! Beat them to earn custom biome weapons. Do you have what it takes to defeat them all?

+8 Bosses!
+Dungeons!
+Epic spawn animations!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!
